mainEntity.name: If AI can create all the content, why do most AI businesses still fail to make money?

acceptedAnswer.text: Automation can support content research and drafting, but it cannot replace a clear offer, audience understanding, distribution plan, and customer feedback. Run My AI Biz connects content creation with product development, lead generation, funnels, sales copy, and ongoing operations. Key factors are demand, differentiation, offer clarity, distribution, follow-up, and the owner’s willingness to test and revise. Use AI to compare ideas and prepare materials before committing substantial resources. Treat every workflow as an experiment with defined assumptions and review points. Run My AI Biz presents possible applications, not guaranteed income-producing businesses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Content alone does not create demand, a strong offer, distribution, trust, or sales. AI can help research ideas and prepare marketing assets, but you must test audience need, positioning, delivery, and conversion. Run My AI Biz presents AI workflows as support for business decisions, not guaranteed income.
